LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ModeDesc:
Switch this arm's job.

Loader: takes from the storage behind it and puts onto the conveyor in front of it, sending only what the network's machine still needs.

Feeder: stands at the end of a belt and puts what arrives into the machine input (factory hopper or conveyor) in front of it. Anything no longer wanted is set down beside it.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderNoBelt: No conveyor in front of it.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderNoFeeder: Its belt does not lead to a Feeder.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.NoMachine: No factory machine takes input from the cell in front of the Feeder.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderBeltBusy: Waiting for room on the belt.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.MachineSatisfied: The machine needs nothing right now.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.MachineCovered: Everything the machine needs is already on its way.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderNoStock: Nothing in its storage the machine wants ({0}).
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeederPaused: Paused: its belts already lead to {0}.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeederSlotFull: The machine's input is full; holding the belt.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeederDropped: Set down {0}: nothing wants it any more.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftNoPartner: No partner lift. Build one on the same spot a level up or down, or link one by hand.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftPartnerNoBelt: No conveyor in front of the partner lift.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftWaiting: Waiting for room on the partner's belt.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftLinkDesc: Choose another conveyor lift for this one to send to. A link made by hand overrides the automatic pairing between levels.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftUnlinkDesc: Remove the hand-made link and go back to pairing with the lift a level up or down.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeederPriorityDesc: When this Feeder's belts start at a belt junction, a higher priority gets first claim on what comes down the trunk. Feeders of equal priority take turns.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeedingFromJunction: Feeding the {0} through a junction ({1} loader(s) on its own belts).
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ServingJunction: Loading a junction trunk for {0} machine(s).
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.JunctionSummary: Splitting to {0} machine(s), fed by {1} loader(s) on the trunk.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.JunctionNoBranches: No branch belts lead from this junction to a Feeder.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.JunctionWaiting: Holding {0} until its branch has room.
